name: Walnut Molasses Bars
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Pour water over butter and lard, then add sugar, molasses mixed with soda, flour, salt, and spices.
Chill thoroughly, roll one-fourth inch thick, cut in strips three and one-half inches long by one and one-half inches wide.
Sprinkle with nut meat and bake ten minutes.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
